title: Forest development unit of an approved FSP

value: A forest licence, tree farm licence, community forest agreement, timber licence or major licence to cut
BC Timber Sales, under a timber sale licence
No
Partly

finding: Outside a forest landscape area the holder may not apply for a cutting or road permit, harvest or build a road on land that no forest development unit of its approved forest stewardship plan contains.

actions.description: Amend the forest stewardship plan to add the area to a forest development unit, and have the amendment approved, before applying.

exceptions.label: The harvest or road is only for a FRPA §4 purpose: a safety hazard, seed collection leaving 1 ha or less, removing felled trees from landings and rights of way, up to 500 m³ at risk from insects, fire or disease, or a prescribed purpose
evidence: The purpose and the volume or opening

exceptions.label: The harvest or road is under a cutting or road permit issued before the forest stewardship plan that covered it expired or the holder left it (§3(1.1))
evidence: The permit and its issue date
The plan’s expiry or the holder’s removal

title: What the FSP identifies in the unit

value: A forest licence, tree farm licence, community forest agreement, timber licence or major licence to cut
BC Timber Sales, under a timber sale licence
No
Partly

finding: The forest stewardship plan must identify, for the forest development unit, each such area in effect 4 months before the plan or amendment was submitted; this one is not shown.

actions.description: Check the plan against the area as it stood 4 months before submission. If it was in effect then, the plan is missing it; if it came later, record what governs it now, such as its order or the plan’s results and strategies.

title: Site plan before harvest

value: A forest licence, tree farm licence, community forest agreement, timber licence or major licence to cut
BC Timber Sales, under a timber sale licence
No
Partly

finding: A site plan for the cutblock and its roads must be prepared before harvest starts, consistent with the forest stewardship plan and showing how the plan's results or strategies apply to the site.

actions.description: Prepare the site plan with the block layout, unless a prescribed circumstance exempts it, and keep it with the block record.

title: Forest operations map before applying

value: A forest licence, tree farm licence, community forest agreement, timber licence or major licence to cut
BC Timber Sales, under a timber sale licence
No
Partly

finding: A forest stewardship plan holder may apply for a cutting or road permit only after the forest operations map showing it has been made public for review and comment and a report on that review has gone to government.

actions.description: Publish the map with both notices, run the review, then submit the review report before the permit application.

exceptions.label: The harvest or road is only for a FRPA §4(1)(a)–(c) or (d)(ii) purpose (§15.1(4)): a safety hazard, seed collection leaving 1 ha or less, removing felled trees from landings and rights of way, up to 500 m³ at risk from insects, fire or disease, or a prescribed purpose
evidence: The purpose and the volume or opening

title: Forest operations map review period

value: A forest licence, tree farm licence, community forest agreement, timber licence or major licence to cut
BC Timber Sales, under a timber sale licence
No
Partly

finding: The review period ran shorter than 30 days from the date both notices were out, and the minister set no shorter period.

actions.description: Count the period from the later of the website and newspaper notices. Run the review again for the full period, or file the minister’s determination of a shorter one.

exceptions.label: The minister set a shorter period as needed to respond to risks to the environment, forest health or wildfire (FPPR §34.2(3)(b)(ii))
evidence: The minister’s determination of the shorter period

title: Applying within 3 years of the map

value: A forest licence, tree farm licence, community forest agreement, timber licence or major licence to cut
BC Timber Sales, under a timber sale licence
No
Partly

finding: The permit application comes more than 3 years after the map's review period began, so the holder cannot rely on that map.

actions.description: Publish a new forest operations map showing the cutblock or road and review it again before applying.

finding: On these answers the minister must refuse the cutting or road permit: the applicant holds no plan for the area, did not publish the forest operations map, or the block or road departs from the locations the map shows.

actions.description: Resolve the ground before applying: a plan that covers the area, a published and reviewed map, or a new map whose cutblock and road locations match the application.

exceptions.label: The harvest or road is only for a FRPA §4 purpose: a safety hazard, seed collection leaving 1 ha or less, removing felled trees from landings and rights of way, up to 500 m³ at risk from insects, fire or disease, or a prescribed purpose, for which no forest stewardship plan or map is required
evidence: The purpose and the volume or opening

title: Forest operations plan in a forest landscape area

value: Yes
Partly

finding: In a forest landscape area the minister must refuse a cutting or road permit unless the applicant holds a forest operations plan for the area and the block and road match its proposed cutblocks and roads.

actions.description: Confirm the forest operations plan in effect for the area and compare the block and road with the cutblocks and roads it proposes.

title: Cutting permit

value: A forest licence, tree farm licence, community forest agreement, timber licence or major licence to cut
A woodlot licence

finding: Harvest under the licence needs a cutting permit whose area takes in the block.

actions.description: Apply for the cutting permit once the plan and map requirements are met, and record the licence and permit numbers with the block.

exceptions.label: Harvesting without a cutting permit is specifically authorized under the Forest Act or another enactment (§52.02(3))

title: Special purpose area · licence or cutting permit
finding: No cutting permit, timber sale licence or forestry licence to cut may be issued with rights in a special purpose area unless an exception applies.

actions.description: Take the block out of the special purpose area, or document the licence purpose that brings it within an exception.

exceptions.label: A forestry licence to cut entered into for fire, forest health or public safety, or a cutting permit under one (§209(2)(a), (c))
evidence: The licence and the purpose it was entered into for

exceptions.label: An area-based or forest licence entered into for the special purpose area’s own purposes (§223(2)–(3))
evidence: The licence and the designation’s purpose

title: Special purpose area · new road
finding: No road permit may authorize a new road in the special purpose area unless a §215(2) ground applies.

actions.description: Route the road outside the area, or document the §215(2) ground the official is to be satisfied of.

exceptions.label: The road does not significantly interfere with the area’s purposes (§215(2)(a))
exceptions.decidedBy: An authorized official, satisfied that the ground applies

exceptions.label: The road is needed for a fire, forest health or safety licence to cut, or a cutting permit under it (§215(2)(b), (d))
exceptions.decidedBy: An authorized official, satisfied that the ground applies

exceptions.label: The road is needed for a licence to cut entered into before the designation (§215(2)(c))
exceptions.decidedBy: An authorized official, satisfied that the ground applies
